title: Onboarding · round 3
intro: Claude Design, 23 Nov. Your picks: r1 all A, Clone later, editor B (Neovim on silently). New positioning away from one agent vendor: a garage you set up your way.

Positioning A (designer's pick) · "Your garage. Agents welcome." B · "A workshop you set up yourself." C · "Where your agents clock in." Hero = Home in the morning: a cron-started brief, a review loop graph, schedules and a trigger, backlog, a wiki page, an aside beside the session. Claude Code only in small print.
About (102): "Your garage on the Mac, set up your way. Agents work with your backlog, wiki, schedules and processes."

Editor B: nothing asked at first run; VS Code in Settings › General › Editors and the palette; nvim import stays Neovim's question, but only when Code opens to edit (not for a review); both editors off hides Review changes, Full diff, Open in editor.
